contract.actor: the existing single retained native video codec thread and capacity-one request channel
contract.input: shallow-cloned canonical IMAGE plus reduced frame rate, exact floating CRF bits, bounded ordered metadata, caller stream, scratch, and cancellation
contract.native_lifetime: the AV1 WebM session, AVIO output, suite borrow, and every FFmpeg pointer remain on and drop on the actor thread
contract.portable_output: one exact-length contiguous rank-one CPU U8 Tensor plus dimensions, reduced frame rate, frame count, SHA-256, ten-bit YUV420P10LE identity, and no alpha

test_cases: LTXV preprocessing, VP9 alpha, and AV1 owned-byte materialization execute serially on one non-caller actor thread
the AV1 request preserves IMAGE identity, exact CRF bits, ordered metadata, rate, stream, scratch, and cancellation
the returned AV1 Tensor is Send plus Sync, CPU U8 contiguous, exact length, content-digest bound, ten-bit, and non-alpha
scratch is zero before the successful response while backend resident bytes remain until Tensor drop
pre-materialization cancellation and backend allocation exhaustion remain owned by the shared portable-byte materializer
